name: ProcessActivityTimeline
description: Timeline widget for displaying BAW process activities with status tracking, assignee information, and duration metrics

configOptions.name: processInstanceId
configOptions.label: Process Instance ID
configOptions.description: BAW process instance ID to automatically fetch activity data (e.g., '2072.1072'). Leave empty to use manual data binding.

configOptions.name: baseUrl
configOptions.label: BAW Base URL
configOptions.description: BAW server base URL for API calls (default: current server)

configOptions.name: showTimestamps
configOptions.label: Show Timestamps
configOptions.description: Display timestamp information for each activity

configOptions.name: compact
configOptions.label: Compact Mode
configOptions.description: Use compact spacing for timeline activities

configOptions.name: clickable
configOptions.label: Clickable
configOptions.description: Enable click interaction on timeline activities

configOptions.name: activityClicked
configOptions.label: Activity Clicked
configOptions.description: Event fired when a timeline activity is clicked
